text:
amy: Opened PR #8140 — docs: private-deploy migration guide + SDK examples. Includes a snippet with a sample ARN and an API key placeholder. Need security + legal review before main merge.
jules: Can you drop the snippet inline here? I'll scrub if needed.
amy: snippet: ```python
client = RedwoodClient(api_key=\"sk-prod-xyz\")
client.configure(kms_arn=\"arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:999999999999:key/AAAaaabbb\")
```
security-team: Flagging: that ARN pattern and api key format match our sensitive patterns. Please replace with placeholders like `<API_KEY>` and `<KMS_KEY_ARN>`. Also convert the runnable block into a non-executable code block (```text) so the docs-preview doesn't attempt to run it.
legal-team: Please ensure there are no customer account identifiers visible. For migration guides we prefer synthetic examples and an explicit note near the top: "Do not include production credentials or account identifiers in docs."
amy: Understood — I'll push a commit with placeholders and add the note. Jules, do you want me to also add a short redaction checklist in the PR body?
jules: Yes please. Add commit hash for the redaction and a 1-line checklist so legal knows what changed.
amy: Pushed commit e3b2c4: replaced secret-looking strings, changed code fence to ```text, added top-line guidance and a brief redaction checklist in PR body.
ci-bot: preview failed for PR #8140: sensitive-checker detected 1 match in private-deploy/migration.md:45 (ARN pattern).
amy: Hmm run locally to see what's left.
security-team: It might be in an embedded link or alt text. Search for `arn:` across the branch.
amy: Found it in an example table, fixed and pushed commit e3b2c5. Re-run CI?
docs-preview: re-run triggered by e3b2c5.
docs-preview: preview passed for PR #8140  artifacts: https://ci.internal/preview/8140/
legal-team: Quick review: placeholders present and top-line guidance included. Approve for staging. Final legal approval will be required before merging to main.
jules: Timeline: I want to merge to docs-staging tonight at 23:00 UTC for a canary. Anyone opposed?
security-team: OK to merge to staging since CI is green and placeholders are in place. Recommend adding a follow-up internal ticket to add pre-commit checks to catch ARN patterns in tables.
amy: Will file follow-up ticket after merge. Merging to docs-staging now.
docs-preview: merged PR #8140 to docs-staging by amy. Release note: "Canary: private-deploy migration guide (PR #8140) — redaction applied; legal pending final sign-off before main."
legal-team: We'll review the staging canary and provide final sign-off or request additional redaction if anything else shows up.
amy: Thanks everyone. Closing thread, will follow up if legal asks for further changes.
